CNN wants to hear from both Russian residents and worldwide viewers, in English or in Russian, what they think about Russia's role in the international community. Send us your comments via Sound Off below. or send your videos and pictures via iReport or to youtube.com/CNN. The best will be posted online to be read and watched by CNN.com Youtube audiences around the world, while English language contributions have the additional opportunity to feature on air in CNN's programming output. "We want our compelling interviews and reports to stand alongside the very best in audience commentary to provide a really lively insight into what contemporary Russia looks like at a time when its impact is being felt not just in politics but in a diverse array of other fields. We're also excited to offer an online outlet for the first time for Russian language audience feedback as well." The week of programming kicks off with a special travelogue documentary Eye on Russia: Moving Forward where CNN's Moscow-based Senior International Correspondent Matthew Chance rides the train from the Arctic north of Murmansk down to the southern climes of Sochi by way of St Petersburg and Moscow, to offer a diverse range of reports. He visits a Russian farm to look at the country's ambitions to be an agricultural superpower, checks out the Star City astronaut training center, meets with seven-foot boxing world champion-turned-movie star Nikolai Valuev and talks along the way with entrepreneurs and environmentalists working to make the city of Sochi home to green Olympics in 2014. CNN also catches up with famous faces like NHL hockey star Alexander Ovechkin, Russian Vogue editor in chief Aliona Doletskaya, A list model Natalia Vodianova, acclaimed conductor Valery Gergiev, the "Russian Madonna" singer Valeriya, and London-based Russian art collector Nonna Materkova to bring together an eclectic mix of Russians who have made it on the world stage. Additionally, there are reports on Russian communities around the world that have sprung up in places as different as Ashdod, Israel and Brighton Beach, New York. CNN is also live every night from a range of iconic Moscow locations as Chance gives his topical insights into a country increasingly at the center of international headlines, to complement a range of interviews with top Russian CEOs and industry leaders airing throughout CNN's prime time evening programming. From St Basil's Cathedral, the Kremlin, Christ the Saviour Cathedral and Manej Square, Chance gives us the latest on what makes the Russia of today, from domestic and foreign policy, to business, to culture. The Eye on series has travelled around the world visiting France, Russia, India, South Korea, China, South Africa, Brazil, Beirut and Poland.

*Three-Hour Live Event to Feature On-the-Ground Reporting from Moscow, In-Depth Explorations of Culture, Space, and Agriculture, Plus Exclusive Reports on Diaspora Communities in New York and Israel.*

**NEW YORK, NY – October 24, 2024** — Global News Network (GNN) today announced an unprecedented, three-hour live television event, **"Russia: Land of Contrasts,"** set to air on **Sunday, November 17, at 8:00 PM ET / 5:00 PM PT**. 

Hosted by award-winning international correspondent Elena Rostova, the special promises an unprecedented, 360-degree look at the nation’s complex political landscape, rich cultural heritage, technological ambitions, and vast agricultural heartland. 

Anchored live from iconic Moscow locations—including breathtaking vantage points overlooking **Red Square, the Kremlin, and Zaryadye Park**—the special will combine real-time reporting with immersive mini-documentaries.

### **Key Highlights of the Broadcast:**

*   **Politics & Geopolitics:** Anchors live in Moscow will analyze the current political climate, domestic policies, and Russia’s evolving role in global affairs, featuring insights from leading political analysts, historians, and everyday citizens.
*   **Culture & Arts:** Viewers will be taken behind the scenes at the historic Bolshoi Theatre, explore the vibrant underground art scene in St. Petersburg, and witness how centuries-old traditions are adapting to the digital age.
*   **The Frontiers of Space:** An exclusive segment from Star City (Zvezdny Gorodok), the legendary training facility for cosmonauts, looking into Russia’s history in the Space Race and its current ambitions for lunar exploration and deep-space travel.
*   **The Agricultural Revival:** A deep dive into Russia’s vast "Black Earth" region and Siberian farmlands, examining how the nation transformed into a global agricultural powerhouse and wheat exporter despite harsh climates and economic shifts.
*   **Sports Empire:** A feature on the deep-rooted passion for Russian ice hockey, figure skating, and chess, exploring how youth academies continue to train world-class athletes amid shifting international sports dynamics.

### **Global Perspective: The Diaspora Stories**

Beyond Russia’s physical borders, the special presents two deeply human reports on the global Russian diaspora:

*   **Tel Aviv & Haifa, Israel:** A look at how over one million Russian-speaking immigrants have reshaped Israeli society, technology, and cuisine over the past three decades, creating a unique hybrid identity that bridges the Middle East and Eastern Europe.
*   **Brighton Beach, New York:** A colorful exploration of Brooklyn’s famous "Little Russia," investigating how generations of Russian-Americans maintain their language, culinary traditions, and community ties in the heart of New York City.

"Russia is a nation of immense scale and profound contradictions that cannot be understood through a single lens," said Sarah Jenkins, Executive Producer of GNN Special Events. "With 'Russia: Land of Contrasts,' we aim to bring viewers an objective, comprehensive, and captivating look at the country’s past, present, and future—from the wheat fields of Voronezh and the launchpads of Baikonur to the streets of Brooklyn and Tel Aviv."

**"Russia: Land of Contrasts"** will stream simultaneously on the GNN App and GNN.com, with interactive features allowing viewers to access extended interviews and 360-degree virtual tours of the Moscow broadcast locations.

For more information, press kits, and preview clips, visit **www.gnn.com/specials/russia-land-of-contrasts**.

counterfactuals.prompt: Can you write an article previewing CNN's "Eye on Russia" series, focusing on how viewer contributions in both English and Russian will be featured on-air and online?
counterfactuals.output:
**Headline:** Beyond the Headlines: CNN Invites Global Audience to Shape "Eye on Russia" Series in English and Russian

As geopolitical dynamics continue to shift, understanding the multi-faceted reality of life inside and around Russia has never been more critical—or more complex. Seeking to look beyond traditional headlines, CNN is preparing to launch its latest multi-platform initiative, **"Eye on Russia."** 

The upcoming series promises an immersive dive into the country’s politics, economy, culture, and daily life. But its defining feature isn’t just top-tier investigative reporting from CNN veterans; it is a groundbreaking crowd-sourcing effort that directly integrates the voices, video, and commentary of viewers in both English and Russian across broadcast and digital platforms.

### A Bilingual Bridge for Grassroots Perspectives

At the heart of "Eye on Russia" is the recognition that the most authentic stories often come from the ground up. To capture the nuance of a nation spanning eleven time zones, CNN is opening its doors to User-Generated Content (UGC) from citizens inside Russia, the broader Russian-speaking diaspora, and international observers tracking the region.

By accepting submissions in both English and Russian, the network aims to bridge a critical communication gap. 

*   **For Russian speakers:** The initiative offers a direct, global platform to share first-hand accounts, local imagery, and personal stories without the filter of external translation bias. CNN’s dedicated editorial team will translate selected Russian-language submissions, bringing grassroots perspectives directly to an international audience.
*   **For English speakers:** The platform provides a space for international analysts, expatriates, and global citizens to share their observations, ask questions, and engage with the material.

This dual-language approach aims to create a dynamic cross-cultural dialogue, contrasting everyday realities with high-level political rhetoric.

### Seamlessly Blending On-Air and Online Coverage

"Eye on Russia" will operate as a fully integrated multi-platform experience, ensuring that viewer contributions aren't just an afterthought, but a central driver of the narrative.

**On-Air Integration:**
Selected viewer-submitted videos, voice notes, and eye-witness accounts will be featured in special segments across flagship programs on CNN International and CNN US. Anchor-led discussions will directly respond to themes raised by the audience, with real-time translation provided for Russian-language audio and text submissions. Highlighting these voices on TV gives global visibility to everyday experiences, from life in remote Siberian towns to the economic realities facing urban centers like Moscow and Saint Petersburg.

**Online and Social Hubs:**
Online, CNN.com will host a dedicated "Eye on Russia" digital hub. This interactive space will feature:
*   **Bilingual Feature Galleries:** Curated photo and video submissions from viewers, accompanied by context from CNN journalists.
*   **Interactive Q&As:** Live digital forums where Russian- and English-speaking audiences can submit questions to CNN’s foreign correspondents and regional experts.
*   **Deep-Dive Digital Articles:** Expanded coverage built around compelling personal stories submitted by the public.

### A New Era of Citizen-Informed Journalism

In an era often dominated by information silos and restricted media environments, CNN’s dual-language audience focus is a deliberate effort to foster transparency and engagement. 

"We want to give our global audience a front-row seat to the real stories shaping Russia today," says a project producer. "By welcoming contributions in both Russian and English, we are allowing the people who live and breathe these experiences—as well as those observing from afar—to help tell the story."

### How to Participate

As CNN prepares for the official launch of "Eye on Russia," the network is already inviting the public to submit their stories, short videos, photos, and commentary. Submissions in both English and Russian can be uploaded via the official CNN website or shared across social media platforms using the dedicated campaign hashtag **#CNNEyeOnRussia**.

Whether analyzing global policy or capturing a quiet moment in a local market, "Eye on Russia" aims to prove that the most complete picture of a nation is painted when everyone has a chance to share what they see.

***

*"Eye on Russia" is scheduled to premiere next month across CNN International, CNN.com, and CNN’s social platforms.*
